name: ICT_SMC_Strategy
description: ICT/SMC Strategy - Fair Value Gap + Liquidity + Market Structure Break
entry_conditions: Identify Market Structure (Higher Highs / Lower Lows)
Find Order Blocks (last bearish candle before bullish move, or vice versa)
Look for Fair Value Gaps (FVG) - 3 candle pattern with gap
Wait for liquidity sweep (stop hunt above/below key levels)
Entry on FVG fill or Order Block retest
Confirm with displacement (strong move away from level)
Entry must align with higher timeframe bias
exit_conditions: Take Profit at next liquidity pool (equal highs/lows)
Move SL to breakeven after 1:1 RR
Close all if market structure shifts
Time-based exit: close before major news events
